title: Woh Faisla Aur Waqt
caption:
kabhi kabhi ek galat kadam poore safar ko badal deta hai, aur hum sirf pachtawe ke saath wahin thehar jaate hain. kya aapne bhi kabhi koi aisa faisla liya hai jise aap badalna chahte hain? 🍂🛤️💭

Mool rachna — page_of_the__soul

#yaadein #pachtawa #zindagi #safar
poem: ek pal ki zidd mein sab chhod aaye,
aaj bhi woh purane raaste yaad hain,
haath mein toh bas khali pan hi hai,
waqt aage badh gaya, hum wahin hain,
kya laut kar kabhi woh din aayenge?
topic: woh decisions jin par aaj bhi regret hota hai
